name: fishball-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It holds only the modules both fishball-core and dsh-instance use, imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies (V3 publishes nothing to a registry).
description: Modules both Fishball sides use: the child admin service protocol, the provider-sync wire codec and engine, and shared file and redaction helpers.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for dsh-instance: './provider-sync-codec' reads the DSH version and './provider-sync-host' adapts the pi-ai provider settings. '*' because the depending package's engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
